name: Durkteel
description: Durkteel was a Mid Rim world with a population of approximately 3.2 billion at the dawn of the Clone Wars. It was the homeworld of the Saurin, a subspecies of Trandoshan with human-like hands. Durkteel was located along the Durkteel Loop.
